dedupe_keys.name: centrifuge testing of liquefaction induced downdrag on axially loaded piles

description: Centrifuge Testing of Liquefaction-Induced Downdrag on Axially Loaded Piles is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Katerina Ziotopoulou, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). Downdrag loads on pile foundations can be an important design consideration when earthquake-induced liquefaction is expected to cause ground settlements. Despite significant research progress on the effects of liquefaction on structures, and the seismic response of piles, there is still a knowledge gap in the assessment of liquefaction-induced downdrag loads on piles. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Drag Load, Downdrag, Piles, Centrifuge Testing. Published 2021-06-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
